summary: Hatay Airport (HTY) serves Antakya, one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, in the Hatay Province of southern Turkey near the Syrian border. The airport provides vital access to a region renowned for its layered history, including the ancient city of Antioch, Roman ruins, and early Christian heritage sites. It primarily handles domestic flights connecting the region to Istanbul and Ankara.
